name: Treg
description: Search and scrape the web, enrich company data, generate media, and call APIs your team has connected to Treg.
notes: Search the catalog by task, then compare inputs, pricing, and measured reliability across providers. Use my_tools to discover the team's registered connections. Treg supplies the provider credential on the server when OpenHands calls an API.
installHint: Sign in to Treg and choose a team during OAuth, or connect with a team API key. To try the connection, use catalog_get with endpoint_id set to treg.web.search. Looking up a tool is free. Paid calls using Treg's provider credentials draw from the selected team's prepaid balance.

auth.credentialHelp: Open Team in the [Treg dashboard](https://treg.to/app) and copy a key from the API Keys tab.
